mathematical_outcome: General verification proof of the compatible Adams lift, not a refutation.

hypotheses: G is a pointed CW subcomplex of E; the manuscript additionally assumes the pair finite.
R is an E-infinity ring spectrum under the sphere.
d is any integer and v: Sigma^infinity E -> Sigma^d S is a stable map.
The unit composite of v restricted to G has a chosen nullhomotopy.
theorem_scope.conclusion: One lift of v^smash ell on the entire at-least-n-G union through Sigma^(d ell) I_R^smash n.
not_asserted: A machine formalization of spectra or infinity-categories.
Uniqueness or permutation-equivariance of the lift.
Verification of downstream compression or radius-of-comparison theorems.
New literature priority or completion of the publishable campaign.

universal_arithmetic.method: Exact integer linear expressions on every closed endpoint-order cone; the cones cover all endpoints satisfying the stated weak inequalities.

two_positive_intervals_give_break.conclusion: Positive overlaps of [a,b] and [c,d] with [l,u], where b<=c, imply l<b<u.

bounded_experiments.classification: Finite experiments supporting the audit, not the proof of the spectral theorem.

formal_core.boundary: The general parameter identities and cardinal arguments are formalized. The coherent cone and stable lift are proved in prose in proof.md, not encoded in Lean or checked by verify.py.

retired_route_diagnostic.interpretation: A finite model of a nonzero loop datum lost by objectwise nullity. It is not a unit-cube counterexample.
